title: Generated residential houses (six styles, importance LOD)

items.name: Nico's house perf pass: per-mesh importance LOD (size and triangle density), no sun shadows from interior and small detail
items.evidence: preview at the spawn view: 576 -> 403 draw calls, 2.32M -> 1.73M tris; at 45 m: 544 -> 260 calls, 2.30M -> 1.47M tris (docs/v2/shots/houses/nico_lod_spawn.png)

items.name: Draw-call and triangle budget per house: near <= 40k tris and about 9 materials (sun shadows only from walls, roofs, structure); mid about 4k tris merged; far shell about 0.5k tris
items.evidence: preview stats: near 3k-37k tris, 12-16 meshes; mid 4k

items.name: Seeded house generator built on the Nico house kit (real boards, sashes, shutters, rails, tiles, clutter; peeling paint and wear)
Six styles: Keys stilt, Florida ranch, Mediterranean barrel tile, art-deco duplex, mid-century modern, bungalow with porch
Variation: palettes, wear, shutters, awnings, bars and grilles, AC units, dishes, solar heaters, porch furniture, house numbers
Yards on map lots: driveways to the road, walks, fences and gates, mailboxes, bins, pools with screen cages, palms and shrubs (instanced), parked cars
items.evidence: docs/v2/shots/houses/distB.png (iron fence, mailbox, bins, hedge, palms)

items.name: Lit windows and porch lights at night (shared night uniform, clustered lamps for near lots)
Importance LOD: near full detail per lot, mid and far merged per cluster with a lot-hide mask, shared materials and textures
items.evidence: Nico street, headless Chrome: 21 lots, 5 at full detail (142k tris), 1 merged mid cluster (85k tris); house build 81 ms total, max 15 ms per near house

items.name: Lot API (lots.js, game.lots): claims, near, at, isFree; world-dressing's spawn-street lots now use the generator
Map house footprints in other districts replaced by generated houses as the city streams (tilebuild skips claimed footprints)
items.evidence: docs/v2/shots/houses/distA.png (Di Lido Island: mid-century and Mediterranean), distB.png (South of Fifth: bungalow, ranch); 48-82 map lots streamed around each spot
